Alex (AE): Quick heads-up: Crescent Fin POC requirements landed. They need SAML SSO (SP-initiated), SCIM provisioning for users+groups, RBAC tied to SCIM groups and domain-based tenant mapping, plus domain ownership proof. They also asked Dedicated pricing and a security review ETA.
Maria (SE): Do we know their IdP?
Tony (Crescent Fin): Okta enterprise. Domains: crescent.com and partners.crescent.com. Use SP-initiated.
Raj (Solutions Eng): Okta SP works. We'll need ACS, EntityID, metadata XML, and NameID format preference. For RBAC are they mapping roles via groups or SAML claims?
Tony (Crescent Fin): Plan to push groups via SCIM; groups map to roles.
Maria (SE): We support SCIM with PATCH for deltas and full sync. Note: very large groups (10k+) may need pagination tuning in our client.
Sylvie (Security): I'll need their SAML metadata, cert rotation policy (they require 90d), SCIM over TLS confirmation, and chosen domain verification method (DNS TXT or email). Any compliance needs?
Tony (Crescent Fin): Internal policy only. Tenant isolation required: users with crescent.com must go to tenant-A.
Raj (Solutions Eng): We can enforce domain->tenant routing. Edge: users with multiple verified domains map to primary domain unless an org attribute overrides.
Maria (SE): POC runbook plan: 1) exchange SAML metadata; 2) enable SCIM via test Okta app; 3) push groups and test RBAC mapping; 4) validate domain binding flows and logout behavior. Snippet for SAML config: ```acs_url: https://api.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs; entity_id: https://redwood-inference.com/saml/sp; nameid_format: email```
Tony (Crescent Fin): Also need session timeout controls and SLO docs.
Maria (SE): We support session TTL and single logout. I'll add cookie/session lifetime expectations to the runbook.
Alex (AE): Pricing: I'll send a 6-month reserved Dedicated ballpark in ~4 hours (includes estimated throughput).
Sylvie (Security): Tony, please upload the vendor security questionnaire; I'll annotate and return within 48 hours.
infra-bot: Reference: https://docs.redwood.com/sso/scim and https://docs.redwood.com/dedicated/pricing
Raj (Solutions Eng): Note: Okta might send group membership via SAML claims instead of SCIM deltas; we'll test both and make mapping idempotent.
Tony (Crescent Fin): We'll start with SCIM push. I'll share metadata + questionnaire EOD.
Maria (SE): Scheduling 30m kickoff tomorrow; I'll include test cases for large-group sync and domain routing.
Alex (AE): Action items: Alex->pricing (4h); Maria->POC runbook + checklist; Sylvie->security review (48h); Raj->large-group sync plan; Tony->share Okta metadata + questionnaire. Keeping thread for updates. :thumbsup:
